name: apexyard
description: ApexYard plugins: ORBIT planning and fork-only add-ons for an ApexYard ops fork.

plugins.name: orbit
plugins.description: ORBIT planning lifecycle: plan, snapshot, reconcile, slice, progress

plugins.name: apexyard-status
plugins.description: Fork-only, display-only status band above the prompt: active ticket, CI state, PRs waiting for /approve-merge, reviewer lock

plugins.name: apexyard-approve
plugins.description: Fork-only, opt-in approval pane: Approve or Not yet for a Rex-approved PR, recorded only by the AgDR-0234 menu hook for the exact head SHA

plugins.name: apexyard-explainer
plugins.description: Display-only pane that explains each tool call in one plain sentence

plugins.name: apexyard-bootcamp
plugins.description: Display-only guided bootcamp pane with nine modules and session checkpoints
